KANNON K. SHANMUGAM

October 28, 2019 

BY MESSENGER AND ELECTRONIC FILING 

Mr. Scott Harris 
Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States 
One First Street, N.E. 
Washington, DC 20543 

Re: 

Seila Law LLC v. Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, No. 19-7 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

I represent petitioner in the above-captioned matter.  I am writing on behalf 
of  all  parties  to  request  extensions  of  time  for  filing  the  merits  briefs  and  joint 
appendix in this case, as follows: 

Brief for the petitioner and joint appendix: 
Brief for the CFPB: 
Brief for Court-appointed amicus: 

December 9, 2019 
December 9, 2019 
January 15, 2020 

All parties have agreed to the foregoing schedule, which would enable this case to be 
heard  during  the  Court’s  February  2020  sitting.    Should  you  need  any  additional 
information, please do not hesitate to let me know. 

Yours sincerely, 

Kannon K. Shanmugam 

cc:  Noel J. Francisco, Esq. (by U.S. mail) 
Paul D. Clement, Esq. (by U.S. mail)
